description: List Official Gazette issues by publication date, newest first, with the number of texts each carries (text_count) and where the issue comes from: source "centre" (the Lebanese University's Centre, whose issues stop about a year back) or "scans" (issues seen in Gazette scans, ids from 2000000000, which cover recent months). since and until accept YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; "everything since January 2025" is since "2025-01". For the next page pass next_cursor as cursor (it is absent on the last page). get_gazette_issue reads one issue's texts. Not legal advice.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous answer; omit for the first page

since.description: first date, inclusive: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

until.description: last date, inclusive: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

name: list_gazette_issues
title: List Official Gazette issues
